four_distinct_passes.name: Actual copper power, motor-phase and return paths
four_distinct_passes.scope: Connectivity/nominal widths; not a measured thermal or transient rating.

remaining_limits: Factory must accept a process for the five U7 via-in-pad holes, or layout must change and be reverified.
Rear D2 plus front ICs/fuses require two-sided full SMT assembly, or D2 must remain a manual operation.
Purchase BOM is not a manufacturer BOM/CPL; socket/module/manual-wire scope must be specified separately.
No verified complete factory-assembled order within100USD including shipping, tax and import charges.
Motor current/torque, real parts fit, soldering, power sequencing, cooling and regenerated energy remain physical qualification tasks.
fallback: Four included spare bare PCBs and the unchanged existing CNC system; the CNC fallback is partial, not five independent new axes.
